titolo: How to use the Claude SEO plugin on your site, and how to check its report
descr: Install the free Claude SEO plugin for Claude Code, check one page and verify the report. Every command, the Windows error we hit, and what the report got wrong.
paragrafi: Claude SEO is a free plugin for Claude Code. It reads a page of your website and tells you what could stop search engines from finding it.
Add the marketplace, install the plugin, and run the first setup. On our PC it took 2 minutes 14 seconds and about 1.3 GB of disk.
Our home page scored 85/100 with the plugin tools, and 82/100 when Claude checked it by hand.
The report found a real redirect problem, but it was wrong about our sitemap: 6,013 of 12,417 addresses still ended in .html.
To remove it, uninstall the plugin and press Y to delete its data.
perche: We did not run the full site audit, speed was not measured, and Claude Code itself needs a paid plan or API credit.
